summary: All requested items pass at 390x844 against the public URL. Backend: 18/18 tests pass (new test_iter21_pdf_arrivo.py plus the test_arrivo_validation.py regression). PDF import was run twice. New PDF (Ankara): numeroOrdine 25024224, dataConsegna 2026-11-16, 3 pedane (2619-021262 ORCHIDEA, 2619-021304 FRUTTA ITALIA V. x2), all with dataArrivo 2026-11-14 and oraArrivo ''. Old PDF: dataConsegna 2026-10-14, ORCHIDEA arrives 2026-10-13, the others 2026-10-14, oraArrivo ''. POST with '15:00 ' or ' 15:00 ' returns 200 and stores '15:00'. dataArrivo '2026-13-45', '2026-02-30' and '2026-00-10' return 422 on POST, and PUT with '2026-13-45' returns 422 without saving any change. Frontend: drag&drop of the new PDF fills 3 rows with Arrivo in magazzino 14/11/2026, empty Ora and the hint 'Giorno dopo la partenza dal fornitore' (shown 3 times). Typing 'abc' and saving shows 'Formato HH:MM' plus the 'Compila i campi obbligatori' toast, and the error disappears while typing the fix. A trailing-space '15:00 ' is sent as '15:00' and stored; after the GET check, all 3 pedane had dataArrivo 2026-11-14. A 422 with an array detail (mocked with page.route) shows the toast 'Dati non validi: controlla i campi', not 'Errore del server'. One minor issue: router.back() after save fails when /ufficio/form is opened directly (no history). Deprecated packages: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch). SafeAreaView issues: none (no SafeAreaView from react-native).

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful save, router.back() throws 'The action GO_BACK was not handled' when the form was opened by direct URL or after a browser refresh (no navigation history). The data is saved, but the user stays on the filled form, so they may save again and create duplicate pedane. Fix: router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/ufficio').

issues: The Ora placeholder is '15:00'. After a PDF import, the gray placeholder can look like a prefilled supplier time, which is the confusion the user just clarified. Consider the placeholder 'HH:MM'.

action_items: LOW: form.tsx doSave: when there is no history, call router.replace('/ufficio') instead of router.back()
LOW (optional): change the Ora placeholder '15:00' to 'HH:MM'
critical_code_review_comments: PedanaIn: the mode='before' strip runs before the pattern check and strptime rejects impossible dates, which is correct. The .strip() calls in create/update are now redundant but harmless.
import_pdf: giorno_dopo returns '' for a missing or invalid dataCarico, so the arrival date then falls back to dataConsegna through dataArrivoEff. This is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 pedane from the form with numeroOrdine TEST_I21_UI_1794605078, deleted by id afterwards (all return 404). Backend tests create TEST_I21_* and TEST_VAL_* records and delete them by id in teardown. No real data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: click accesso-ufficio-button, wait 1s for the sheet animation, fill ufficio-password-input, then dispatch_event('click') on ufficio-login-button (a normal click fails with 'outside viewport' during the animation). For drag&drop, read /tmp/new.pdf (download it from the PDF URL), base64 it into the page, build a File/DataTransfer, and dispatch dragenter+drop on document. Gemini PDF import takes about 10s.
